subject: Seed Launch cohort — support & cost-share request
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@brightlabs.org>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Seed Launch cohort — support & cost-share request

Hi Lauren,

Hope you’re well — BrightLabs is opening registration for our Fall Seed Launch cohort (12 teams, focused on developer tools & infra). Several of the founders used Redwood during the alpha and asked whether we can secure a partner credit package or a cost-share to cover initial usage during the 8-week program.

High-level ask: 12 teams, each needs ~$500 in credits per month for 2 months (estimate ~ $12k total). We’re hoping for either:
- A matching credit (BrightLabs covers half, Redwood covers half) OR
- A one-time promotional grant of $8k credit + pilot pricing (20% off list) for the cohort.

We typically promote partners in our program materials, and we can commit to a short case study and a joint webinar if that helps justify a credit carve-out.

Attached: BrightLabs_Cohort_Rundown.pdf (program overview + expected usage). Can you let me know what exceptions/process we should follow to request this package?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call this week.

—Amy
Amy Chen
Program Director, BrightLabs Accelerator
amy@brightlabs.org
(415) 555-0123

Attachment: BrightLabs_Cohort_Rundown.pdf (PDF, 420KB)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 13:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Seed Launch cohort — support & cost-share request

Hi Amy — thanks for the note and the program brief, this is exactly the kind of partnership we prioritize.

Quick outline of next steps from our side:
1) I’ll loop in Ben (sales lead) and Monica (partnerships) to confirm program-level fit and any promotional commitments.
2) If approved, we’ll propose either a credit-match package or a single promotional grant plus cohort discount. We’ll need an SOW and PO/contact for billing.
3) We typically ask for a short joint webinar and a short quote for the case study you mentioned.

Ben/Monica — can you weigh in on whether we can carve an exception for a one-time grant (~$8k) or prefer a matching credit structure? If we approve a grant, I’ll route for a manager-level exception and have finance prepare a billing addendum.

Amy — I attached the cohort rundown to this thread for our internal review. Happy to set a 30-min sync if helpful.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Attachment referenced: BrightLabs_Cohort_Rundown.pdf (re-attached)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Lauren / Monica — I reviewed the cohort deck. A few quick thoughts:

- The partnership upside (webinar + case study + 12 engaged teams) is solid.
- I’m willing to approve a one-time promotional grant of up to $8,000 in hosted credits OR a 50/50 matching credit (total $12k, Redwood $6k), contingent on:
  * A one-page SOW outlining credit usage and promotional commitments, and
  * Billing contact + PO number (so finance can track the exception).

Please loop in Rafael from RevOps to get final sign-off and to draft the billing addendum/terms we’ll need. Amy — if you can send the billing contact and preferred invoicing cadence that’ll speed things up.

Ben Carter
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Note: This is a manager-level approval — final allocation will be processed through RevOps for accounting treatment.
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Amy Chen <amy@brightlabs.org>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Seed Launch cohort — support & cost-share request

Thanks Ben — I can finalize this on the RevOps side.

Operational checklist for a grant/match:
1) Confirm final structure (Redwood grant $8k vs Redwood match $6k).
2) Provide a one-page SOW signed by BrightLabs that lists: cohort dates, teams covered, credit consumption limits, promotional commitments (webinar/case study).
3) Billing contact + PO (where applicable).
4) We will attach a short addendum to the standard MSA capturing the promotional credit and service limits.

I have drafted an initial addendum (special_terms_redwood_v1.pdf) — it covers credit expiration (90 days), usage caps per team, and reporting expectations. I’ll circulate a DocuSign link once the SOW is attached and the structure confirmed.

Amy — can you confirm: billing@brightlabs.org as billing contact and whether BrightLabs will issue a PO? Also, please confirm if you want Redwood to invoice for your half (if match) or if BrightLabs will invoice for total and handle reimbursements — we can be flexible.

Attaching: special_terms_redwood_v1.pdf (draft addendum).

—Rafael Mendes
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com

Attachment: special_terms_redwood_v1.pdf (PDF, 32KB)

Hi all — sorry for the delay, just confirming details from our side: billing@brightlabs.org is correct and BrightLabs will issue a PO (PO# BL-0926-01). We prefer the Redwood grant of $8k (simpler for our teams) and can commit to the webinar (within 6 weeks of cohort start) and a short case study.

I’ve signed the SOW and uploaded the signed version here (signed_SOW_BrightLabs.pdf). Rafael — please send the DocuSign link or the final addendum when ready and an invoice for any administrative fee if required.

Can we schedule a 30-min onboarding call the week before the cohort (preferred window: Oct 5–9)? Lauren — can you propose 2 times?

Thanks everyone — excited to run this with Redwood.
